On 15.02.2024, the following order was passed :-
"1. Heard Sri Syed Ali Murtaza and Sri Chetan Chatterjee, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Gopal Chaturvedi, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Sri Amit Prakash, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2.
2.
Learned counsel for the parties were encouraged to enter into a conciliation, it was found that both the parties are not ready to live together and there is a break down of marriage.
3. The only question is of compensation which was to be considered through conciliation.
Learned counsel for both the parties have assisted the Court through their parties for conciliation.
The opposite party no.2-wife and her father is present in Court.
4. The deliberations were made and at the end, a sum of Rs.25 lacs as permanent alimony was accepted by both the sides.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that he would not be in a position to pay the whole amount in one stroke.
He seeks some time and fairly submits that the applicant is ready to deposit a sum of Rs.10 lacs as upfront amount within 15 days from today before the Registrar General of this Court.

5. In case, the amount of Rs.10 lacs is deposited by the applicant within 15 days before the Registrar General of this Court, the same shall be kept in a fixed deposit bearing interest in a nationalized bank and a receipt of the same shall be placed on record of this case.
